pay_by_card.shownName: Unable to pay online, would like to try different way of payment

change_comission.description: Set the commission on a project payment: either a percentage or an amount. The other value is recalculated automatically from the payment sum.

params.obj_type: What is being set: comission_percent — commission percentage, any other value — commission as an amount
params.value: The value being set: a percentage or an amount, depending on obj_type

nullify_fees.description: Reset the whole financial picture of the project: paid sums, payment marks and confirmation flags are cleared on every application, payment type budgets are zeroed. The action cannot be undone.

confirm_payment.description: Confirm a fee payment reported by a player: the payment is credited to the application and the player is notified.

params.obj_id: ID of the payment message in the application conversation

decline_payment.description: Reject a fee payment reported by a player: nothing is credited and the player is notified.

params.obj_id: ID of the payment message in the application conversation

verify_transaction.description: Mark a project payment as verified and post it to the budget of the corresponding payment type.

un_verify_transaction.description: Remove the verified mark from a project payment.
